adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration builds an INSERT via string interpolation: `execute "INSERT ... VALUES ('#{h}', ... )"`. If any migrated host line contains a single quote, the SQL becomes invalid and the migration can abort. Also, `val.split("\n")` will include empty strings for blank lines and preserve `\r` from CRLF input; because the migration bypasses model validations/callbacks (which would trim/normalize), it can insert invalid/unsanitized host values (e.g., with `\r`) that later won’t match `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host`’s `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` check.
